title: VIP High-Value Champions
description: Top-tier loyal customers generating substantial marketplace revenue and consistent repeat orders.
suggested_action: Offer exclusive priority dropshipping, dedicated support, and early access to high-margin catalog bundles.

title: Regular Loyal Buyers
description: Consistent customers with steady purchase frequency and moderate average basket value.
suggested_action: Nurture with targeted category cross-sell discounts and seasonal festival campaigns to graduate into VIP tier.

title: Occasional / Casual Shoppers
description: Infrequent buyers placing occasional low-volume orders.
suggested_action: Deploy re-engagement email promotions, time-limited discount vouchers, and free shipping thresholds.
